name: miniflux
description: miniflux + PostgreSQL; every acknowledged category must be stored exactly once.

services.name: postgres
services.cmd: su postgres -s /bin/sh -c "exec $PG/bin/postgres -D /data/pg -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1 -c unix_socket_directories=/tmp -c shared_buffers=32MB -c max_connections=20 -c dynamic_shared_memory_type=mmap"
services.setup:
if [ ! -f /data/pg/PG_VERSION ]; then
  chown postgres /data/pg
  su postgres -s /bin/sh -c "$PG/bin/initdb -D /data/pg -U postgres --auth=trust"
fi

services.name: front
services.description: miniflux itself (named front so the explorer's generators target it)

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  code=$(API -o /tmp/hydo/resp.$i -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 \
         -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"title\":\"c$i\"}" \
         http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/categories)
  case $code in
    201) echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES;;
    4??) echo "$i failed" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES;;     # validation error: not applied
    *)   echo "$i unknown" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES;;    # timeout, 5xx, no connection
  esac
  i=$((i + 1))
done
workload.retry:
i=0
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_STEPS ]; do
  if ! grep -qx $i $HYDO_ACKED; then
    code=$(API -o /tmp/hydo/resp.$i -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 \
           -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"title\":\"c$i\"}" \
           http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/categories)
    # a 400 "already exists" means an earlier attempt was applied: the title is the id
    if [ "$code" = 201 ] || grep -q "already exists" /tmp/hydo/resp.$i; then
      echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES
    fi
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done

invariants.msg: every category the client saw created (HTTP 201) is stored exactly once
invariants.cmd:
PSQL "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 2
for i in $(cat $HYDO_ACKED); do
  n=$(PSQL "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories WHERE title='c$i'")
  [ "$n" = 1 ] || { echo "category c$i stored $n times"; exit 1; }
done
echo "acked=$(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED) exactly once"

invariants.msg: a create the server rejected with a 4xx was not applied
invariants.cmd:
PSQL "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 2
for i in $(cat $HYDO_FAILED); do
  n=$(PSQL "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories WHERE title='c$i'")
  [ "$n" = 0 ] || { echo "category c$i was rejected but is stored"; exit 1; }
done
echo "failed=$(wc -l < $HYDO_FAILED) none applied"

invariants.msg: while the workload runs, every acknowledged category is visible through the API
invariants.cmd:
code=$(API -o /tmp/hydo/cats -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/categories)
[ "$code" = 200 ] || exit 2          # server or database down: cannot evaluate now
list=$(cat /tmp/hydo/cats)
for i in $(cat $HYDO_ACKED); do
  echo "$list" | grep -q "\"title\":\"c$i\"" || { echo "acked c$i missing from the API"; exit 1; }
done
echo "api shows all $(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED) acked"
